title: A protocol for transdifferentiation of human cardiac fibroblasts into endothelial cells via activation of innate immunity
protocol: Prepare a 6-well matrigel coated plate for the recovery of human cardiac fibroblasts.
Incubate the plate for 30 min in a 37°C cell culture incubator.
Thaw and quickly recover one cryovial of commercial human fibroblasts in 1 well of the matrigel coated 6-well plate using 2 mL fibroblast medium.
Replace the medium with fresh 2 mL fibroblast medium following 24 h incubation.
Change medium every 2 days until confluent.
Once confluent, passage the human fibroblasts at a 1:6 split by incubating with 1 mL TrypLE per well for 5 min in a 37°C cell culture incubator.
Plate onto a new 6-well matrigel coated plate to achieve 70%–80% confluency.
Seed iPSCs in matrigel-coated 6-well plate until they reach 80%–85% confluency.
Replace E8 medium with RPMI/B27 minus insulin per well supplemented with 6 μM CHIR99021 for 2 days.
Replace the medium with fresh 2 mL RPMI/B27-insulin per well on day 2 for 24 hours.
Replace the medium with freshly prepared 2 mL RPMI/B27-insulin per well supplemented with 5 μM IWR-1 on day 3 for 2 days.
Replace the medium with fresh 2 mL RPMI/B27-insulin per well on day 5 for 24 hours.

Passage the differentiating cells with 1 mL TrypLE per well and seed them in new matrigel-coated 6-well plates at a 1:12 split ratio in freshly prepared 2 mL Advanced DMEM/GlutaMAX medium per well supplemented with 1% FBS, 5 μM CHIR99021, 2 μM retinoic acid, and 5 μM Y27632 on day 6.
Replace the medium with freshly prepared 2 mL Advanced DMEM/GlutaMAX medium per well supplemented with 5 μM CHIR99021 and 2 μM retinoic acid on day 7 for 2 days.
Replace the medium with fresh 2 mL Advanced DMEM/GlutaMAX medium per well on day 9 for 2 days.

Passage the cells with 1 mL TrypLE per well and seed them in new matrigel-coated 6-well plates at a 1:3 or 1:6 split ratio in freshly prepared 2 mL Advanced DMEM/GlutaMAX medium per well supplemented with 2 μM SB431542 on day 11 for 24 hours.
Replace the medium with fresh 2 mL Advanced DMEM/GlutaMAX medium per well supplemented with 2 μM SB431542 on day 12 and change the medium until cells are confluent.
Passage the cells on day 14 with 1 mL TrypLE per well.
Seed the cells in new matrigel-coated 10 cm cell culture dish at a 1:3 split ratio or seed two full 6-well plates into one 10 cm dish.
Prepare fibroblast growth medium supplemented with 20 ng/mL bFGF and 10 μM SB431542.
Replace the medium with fresh fibroblast growth medium on day 16 per dish.
Replace the medium again with fresh fibroblast growth medium on day 18 per dish.
By day 20, check that the resulting cardiac fibroblasts are confluent and can be passaged for transdifferentiation.
Check the purity of iPSC-CFs by assessing the expression of CF markers such as COL-I, DDR2, and TCF21 via fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS).
Cryopreserve the iPSC-CFs for future use by resuspending them in Bambanker freezing medium.
Place the cells in CoolCell® at −80°C for 24 hours.
Store the cells long-term in liquid nitrogen.
Reconstitute human fibroblasts in a gelatin-coated plate 30 minutes before seeding.
Seed human fibroblasts at a density of 1 × 10^5 cells per well of a 6-well plate with human fibroblast medium for 24 hours.
Aspirate the spent medium and replace it with induction medium containing DMEM/F12 supplemented with 7.5% FBS, 7.5% KSR, and 30 ng/mL poly(I:C).
Treat cells daily with fresh induction medium from day 2 to day 6.
Switch induced human fibroblasts over to transdifferentiation medium on day 7, containing EGM2 medium supplemented with 50 ng/mL VEGF, 20 ng/mL BMP4, and 20 ng/mL bFGF for 2 days.
Replace the spent medium with fresh transdifferentiation medium on day 9 for 2 days.
Replace the spent medium with fresh transdifferentiation medium on day 11 for 2 days.
Replace the spent medium with fresh transdifferentiation medium on day 13 for 1 day.
Switch the transdifferentiated human fibroblasts to maintenance medium containing EGM2, supplemented with VEGF, bFGF, and 8-Br-cAMP on day 14.
Change the medium every 2 days for the next 2 weeks.
Observe cells throughout the protocol for morphological changes.
Aspirate the spent medium on day 28.
Dissociate the cells using TrypLE express at a ratio of 1 mL per well for 10 minutes at 37°C.
Pipette the cells repeatedly to achieve single cell suspension.
Collect the cells in basal EGM2 medium to neutralize TrypLE express.
Strain the cell suspension through a pre-rinsed 40 μm strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend 1 × 10^7 cells in 160 μL ice-cold MACS buffer.
Incubate the cell suspension with 40 μL of CD144 magnetic microbeads at 4°C for 15 min in the dark.
Wash the cells with 1 mL MACS buffer and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Setup LS columns on the magnetic MACS sorting apparatus and pre-rinse them with 3 mL MACS buffer.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with 1 mL MACS buffer.
Pass the cell suspension through the LS column.
Wash the column with 3 mL MACS buffer, repeating it 3 times to remove unlabeled cells.
Remove the column from the magnetic separator and place it on a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 5 mL MACS buffer to the column and firmly push the plunger to elute CD144+ labeled cells.
Prewash the LS columns with MACS buffer to ensure removal of any bubbles.
Wait until all previous wash volume has passed through the column before adding the next volume.
Apply steady and even pressure on the column plunger when plunging the cells from the column.
Centrifuge the CD144+ labeled cells at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in expansion medium containing EGM2 and 10 μM SB431542.
Seed the cells in one well of a 6-well plate precoated with 0.2% gelatin.
Ensure cells are evenly dispersed before placing them in a 37°C incubator.
Maintain transdifferentiated iECs with medium changes every 2 days.
Expand iECs up to 8 passages.
Once confluent, dissociate P0 iECs with 1 mL TrypLE for 5 min at 37°C.
Neutralize the cell suspension with basal EGM2 medium.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cell pellet in expansion medium.
Passage P0 iECs on gelatin-coated plates at a 1:3 split ratio.
Aspirate spent medium from cells before cryopreservation.
Dissociate P1 iECs with 1 mL TrypLE for 5 min at 37°C.
Neutralize the cell suspension with media.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant from cells and resuspend gently with 1 mL Bambanker.
Transfer cell suspension into cryogenic storage vials.
Place vials in CoolCell® freezing container and store in −80°C for 24 h.
Transfer cryogenic vials to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage.
Dissociate iECs from gelatin-coated plates with 1 mL TrypLE for 5 min at 37°C.
Neutralize TrypLE with media and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cell pellet gently in 1× PBS containing 2% FBS at 5 × 10^5 cells per 100 μL volume per tube.
Incubate cells with PE-conjugated antibody against CD31 at a 1:400 dilution for 30 min on ice.
Wash cells to remove excess antibody, centrifuge and resuspend in 1× PBS containing 2% FBS.
Dissociate iECs from 1-well of a 6-well plate using 1 mL TrypLE for 5 min at 37°C.
Neutralize the cells with basal EGM2 media and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Extract RNA using an RNA extraction kit such as Qiagen RNeasy Plus Mini Kit.
Resuspend the pellet with lysis buffer (buffer RLT) to disrupt them by pipetting up and down.
Add equal volume of 70% ethanol to the homogenized cell lysate.
Transfer the cell lysate to RNeasy spin column® to capture the RNA, followed by washes with RW1 and RPE buffers.
Elute RNA with RNAse-free water.
Determine the RNA concentration using a Nanodrop.
Use qScript® cDNA Synthesis Kit for cDNA synthesis.
Thaw the RNA and qScript® cDNA SuperMix on ice and prepare 0.2 mL thin-walled PCR tube for the PCR reaction.
Once mixed, vortex gently and centrifuge to pool the reaction volume.
Place the tubes in a thermal cycler and follow the recommended PCR program.
Dilute the cDNA samples with RNase/DNase-free water in a 1:5 ratio.
Thaw the gene-specific primers on ice.
Prepare the reaction mix for qPCR.
Turn on the ABI Real time PCR machine (ABI 7300) 30 minutes prior to running the qPCR.
Follow the recommended qPCR program.
Analyze the expression of EC genes by normalizing the data to a housekeeping gene (GAPDH).
Express the data as relative fold changes using the ΔCt method of analysis.
Aspirate the media from one well of a 6-well plate.
Wash cells with DPBS.
Fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash cells three times with DPBS.
Block cells with blocking buffer containing 10% normal donkey serum and 1% BSA for 1 hour at room temperature.
Apply CD31 primary antibody diluted in antibody buffer to the cells for 16 hours at 4°C.
Apply CD144 primary antibody diluted in antibody buffer to the cells for 16 hours at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with DPBS.
Apply secondary antibodies diluted in antibody buffer containing 1% normal donkey serum and 1% BSA for 1 hour at room temperature.
Add DAPI during this incubation.
Wash cells five times with DPBS.
Capture images using a fluorescent microscope.
Store cells in PBS at 4°C for future imaging.
Seal the edges of the plate with parafilm to prevent the cells from drying out.
